item.title: NEW: Critical PHP2Shell RCE Flaws Leaked Ahead of Coordinated Patch
item.description:
Headline: Critical PHP2Shell RCE Flaws Leaked Ahead of Coordinated Patch

Summary:
Two critical remote code execution (RCE) vulnerabilities in PHP, collectively named "PHP2Shell," were prematurely disclosed before a scheduled patch release. The flaws, tracked as CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619, affect a vast range of PHP versions from 5.4 onwards, placing a majority of the web at risk. Security researchers have reproduced the exploit, and Cloudflare has already detected initial attack attempts in the wild. Organizations are urged to prepare for immediate patching as soon as the official fixes are released to mitigate the threat of widespread server compromise.

Severity: Critical

Categories: Vulnerability, Cyberattack, Patch Management

Article Type: Advisory

Reading Time: 5 minutes

Meta Description: Two critical remote code execution vulnerabilities in PHP (CVE-2026-109618, CVE-2026-109619), dubbed PHP2Shell, were prematurely disclosed. Active attacks are underway.

item.description:
Headline: CISA Adds Six Flaws to KEV Catalog, Including Plex2Shell Chain

Summary:
The U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) has added six new vulnerabilities to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) catalog, confirming they are under active attack. The update includes four flaws in Plex Media Server, collectively known as "Plex2Shell," which attackers are chaining for unauthenticated RCE to deploy malware. Vulnerabilities in Siemens Software Center and EG Secure Solutions SiteGuard Server Edition were also added. Federal agencies are mandated to patch these flaws by early November 2026.

item.description:
Headline: Lazarus APT Uses AI and Post-Quantum Crypto in New Campaign

Summary:
The North Korean Lazarus APT group has launched a sophisticated cyberespionage campaign named "Operation FlashHole," targeting South Korean entities since July 2025. Researchers at Kaspersky revealed the campaign uses AI-generated content for spear-phishing lures, abuses legitimate South Korean software for initial access, and deploys new malware. Most notably, the group is using post-quantum cryptography (ML-KEM-1024) to encrypt its command-and-control communications, demonstrating a significant advancement in future-proofing its operations against decryption.

item.title: NEW: Weak eMudhra Certificate Keys Force Emergency Browser Blocks
item.description:
Headline: Weak eMudhra Certificate Keys Force Emergency Browser Blocks

Summary:
A major internet security incident occurred after eight intermediate certificates from Indian Certificate Authority (CA) eMudhra were discovered to have critically weak private keys. The flaw, caused by insufficient randomness during key generation, allowed private keys to be recovered almost instantly. In one case, the private key was a single digit. This vulnerability enabled potential man-in-the-middle attacks and certificate forgery, forcing major browser vendors like Mozilla, Google, and Apple to issue emergency updates to distrust and revoke the compromised certificates, protecting users from potential impersonation attacks.

Severity: Critical

Categories: Supply Chain Attack, Vulnerability, Security Operations

Article Type: NewsArticle

Reading Time: 4 minutes

Meta Description: A critical flaw in eMudhra's key generation process led to weak private keys for eight intermediate certificates, forcing an emergency revocation by Google and Mozilla.

Headline: ConnectWise Suspends Services After M365 Supply Chain Attack

Summary:
IT software provider ConnectWise suspended its Cloud Backup and other cloud services following a major supply chain attack. An attacker used a compromised API secret for the ConnectWise Cloud Backup service to gain unauthorized access to the Microsoft 365 tenants of hundreds of its customers. The breach allowed the threat actor to access sensitive data in Exchange, Teams, and SharePoint. ConnectWise has shut down the affected services to investigate, leaving customers unable to access backups or perform restorations for several days.

item.title: NEW: Critical RCE Vulnerabilities in PHP Affect Millions of Web Servers
item.description:
Headline: Critical RCE Vulnerabilities in PHP Affect Millions of Web Servers

Summary:
Two critical remote code execution (RCE) vulnerabilities, CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619, have been disclosed in PHP, a ubiquitous server-side scripting language. Both vulnerabilities carry a CVSS 4.0 score of 9.2, indicating a high risk of exploitation. According to Palo Alto Networks' Cortex Xpanse, over 22.6 million internet-exposed instances are potentially vulnerable. Proof-of-concept (PoC) exploit code is reportedly available, and at least one European government has taken its website offline as a precautionary measure. Immediate patching is strongly recommended for all organizations using PHP to prevent potential server compromise, data theft, or malware deployment.

Severity: Critical

Categories: Vulnerability, Patch Management, Threat Intelligence

Article Type: Advisory

Reading Time: 4 minutes

item.title: NEW: Ransomware Gangs Exploit PAN-OS Flaw for Network Access
item.description:
Headline: Ransomware Gangs Exploit PAN-OS Flaw for Network Access

Summary:
Ransomware operators, including the groups behind Qilin (Spikey Scorpius) and Inc (Tarnished Scorpius), are actively exploiting a critical authentication bypass vulnerability in Palo Alto Networks' PAN-OS software, tracked as CVE-2026-0257. The flaw, which resides in the GlobalProtect VPN component and is listed in CISA's KEV catalog, allows attackers to gain initial access and bypass MFA. Following exploitation, attackers have been observed moving laterally to vCenter servers, disabling security controls on ESXi hypervisors, and using custom tools to perform offline credential dumping from domain controller virtual disks (VMDKs). This sophisticated tactic bypasses EDR and other in-guest security controls. Organizations in healthcare, education, finance, and other sectors are being targeted, and immediate patching is critical.

Severity: Critical

Categories: Ransomware, Vulnerability, Threat Actor

Article Type: Report

Reading Time: 6 minutes

Meta Description: Ransomware operators, including Qilin (Spikey Scorpius) and Inc (Tarnished Scorpius), are exploiting PAN-OS vulnerability CVE-2026-0257 for initial access.

Summary:

The flaw, rated 8.4 on the CVSS v4.0 scale, is being leveraged by the 'ClickFix' malware campaign. Attackers trick users into running a malicious installer that bundles a legitimate, older version of SSC with a malicious DLL, leading to arbitrary code execution. Siemens has released an update and urges customers to apply it.

item.title: NEW: Ransomware Gangs Exploit PAN-OS Auth Bypass to Infiltrate Networks
item.description:
Headline: Ransomware Gangs Exploit PAN-OS Auth Bypass to Infiltrate Networks

Summary:
Ransomware operators, including the groups known as Spikey Scorpius (Qilin) and Tarnished Scorpius (Inc), are actively exploiting a critical authentication bypass vulnerability, CVE-2026-0257, in Palo Alto Networks' PAN-OS software. This flaw in the GlobalProtect feature allows attackers to gain initial access and establish VPN sessions without valid credentials, bypassing multi-factor authentication. Security researchers at Unit 42 have observed advanced post-exploitation TTPs where attackers pivot from the compromised VPN gateway to the vCenter management appliance. From there, they disable security settings on ESXi hypervisors and use custom tooling to perform offline credential dumping against a domain controller's virtual disk (VMDK), a technique that evades typical EDR and in-guest security controls. Organizations are strongly urged to apply patches immediately.

Severity: Critical

Categories: Vulnerability, Ransomware, Threat Actor

Article Type: Advisory

Reading Time: 4 minutes

Meta Description: Ransomware operators, including Qilin and Inc, are exploiting PAN-OS vulnerability CVE-2026-0257 to bypass MFA and gain network access. Patch now.
